page.overview:
Who is United States Armed Forces?

Marine Corps Air Force Coast Guard |Headquarters=Various|Bases=Various|Members=Cecil Stedman (formerly) Brit (formerly) Donald Ferguson (formerly) Jerry † Unnamed Sergeant † Tania Nate Various others|Allies=Global Defense Agency Guardians of the Globe|Status=Active|First Appearance=2x05 "It's Not That Simple"|Home=United States of America|Enemies=Lizard League Mauler Twins}}

The United States Armed Forces is the federal military of the United States of America, intended to fight a variety of threats ranging from terrorism (by supervillains) to kaiju attacks and extraterrestrial invasions.

The U.S Military's history existed long before the Viltrumite known as Nolan arrived, founded somewhere around the late 18th century over 245 years ago during the beginning of the American Revolutionary War.

In the modern era, the military had a base in Anderson, Wyoming, that was attacked by the Lizard League, and later the Mauler Twins.
